judge_runtime.scheduling: per model, stage: full_input_tokens descending then frozen sample index; no label-dependent ordering
judge_runtime.loading: offline exact pinned model/tokenizer/config/template files; bind weight hashes, package versions, code, driver/GPU and actual effective decoding config before and after execution
judge_runtime.scope: Adopt qualified pilot numerical/grammar settings. A separate v3 runner must bind new sampling/seed/response roles; sealed engineering pilot CLIs must not be relabeled as substantive runners.

prompt.renderer: same pilot renderer: system message then json.dumps({task_definition, documents:[{label:A,text:text_a},{label:B,text:text_b}]}, ensure_ascii=False); pinned model chat template, add_generation_prompt=True; tokenize add_special_tokens=False, truncation=False
prompt.displayed_fields: complete original texts and fixed task only; no IDs, score, stratum, method, tags, native duplicate labels, prior answers, outcomes or desired conclusion
prompt.reason_limit: <=80 Python str.split words and <=600 characters; strict final schema; no JSON repair or fence stripping
prompt.untrusted_text_rule: document instructions are quoted source data; model receives no tools/retrieval and never sees the other model response

model_labels.primary_positive_rule: both distinct-family judge outputs valid and positive
model_labels.uncertain_disagreement_unavailable_rule: binary positive/nonpositive disagreement, uncertainty, or unavailable: zero positive numerator; retain full denominator weight and distinct status. Different positive categories remain panel-positive and are logged as six-way disagreement.
model_labels.label_function: y(pair)=1 iff both model calls have status valid and categories in the two positive categories; else 0

calibration.validation_frame: ALL score>locked_tau calibration pairs; not only model positives
calibration.bound_target: fixed/potential conservative two-model-panel label function under the locked runtime and uniform-draw sampling model; not semantic truth, human judgment, or independent model votes
calibration.selection_bin_edges: nearest FP64 decimal edges; left closed/right open/final endpoint closed; saturate bin only, never clip raw scores
calibration.selection_sampling: independent reservoir SRS without replacement per bin; census if bin population <30
calibration.selection_estimator: ratio of Horvitz-Thompson weighted positives to weighted sampled above-threshold pairs; exact rational inclusion weights
calibration.selection_threshold_rule: least strict existing grid threshold with weighted ratio >=19/20 and nonzero support; predicate raw_score > float(tau)
calibration.validation_sampling: independent reservoir SRS without replacement from ALL above-threshold calibration pairs, including selection/pilot overlap, model nonpositive/uncertain/unavailable cases; census if N<200
calibration.validation_bound: one-sided exact finite-population hypergeometric lower proportion; alpha=1/20; >=9/10 required; empty population/sample is undefined and fails
calibration.no_threshold_pass_policy: 0.995 remains failed diagnostic only; no substantive validation pass or post-outcome representation/prompt/judge substitution
calibration.validation_failure_policy: stop this configuration, retain failure; any substantive change requires a new protocol and evaluation whose prior exposure is disclosed

randomness.canonical_serialization: UTF-8 JSON ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(comma,colon), allow_nan=False; exact text/IDs, no Unicode normalization
randomness.seed_generation: Before selection observations, draw independent 256-bit OS seeds for selection, validation, selection_swap and validation_swap; record exact hex seeds and creation provenance in immutable v3 activation lock. Never search seeds or regenerate them after labels/scores/outcomes. No seeds drawn by this plan.
randomness.sampling_rng: Python random.Random(int(domain_digest(sampling,[plan_file_sha256,frame_sha256,stage,seed_hex,bin_index_or_null]),16)); one independent selection stream per bin; separate validation/swap domains via stage. Same frozen reservoir algorithm and uniform-draw SRS model as phase3, not a cryptographic/exact-PRNG-randomness claim.
randomness.sampling_order: complete frozen pair-score stream with block size/scorer/runtime/order pinned before selection; reservoir samples serialized in row-index order. Swaps draw from each complete stage sample in that order.
randomness.natural_pair_id: domain_digest(natural_pair,[frame_sha256, sorted(record_ids by UTF-8 bytes)]); unordered, stable across stages
randomness.canonical_orientation: UTF-8-byte sorted IDs; reverse iff int(domain_digest(orientation,[plan_file_sha256,frame_sha256,natural_pair_id]),16) mod 2 == 1; same orientation across both models and selection/validation
randomness.model_seed: int(domain_digest(model_seed,[plan_file_sha256,frame_sha256,opaque_pair_id,model_id,model_revision]),16) mod 2^63; same seed for canonical replay and swapped diagnostic, independent of stage/call index

validation_stability.overlap_rule: For selection/validation overlap under identical canonical orientation, compare each model status and each valid six-way category. Any category change OR status/availability change makes model validation unavailable due to instability, regardless of the numerical lower bound. No majority over repeats, relabeling, agreement retries or outcome-dependent exclusion.
validation_stability.no_overlap_limit: Absence of replayed overlap does not establish label-function stability elsewhere; report zero overlap explicitly.
validation_stability.statistical_assumption: Bounds condition on a fixed/potential panel-label function. Passing observed replay checks does not prove deterministic stability on unsampled pairs or semantic accuracy.

swapped_diagnostics.pairs_per_stage: ceil(actual stage sample count/10), SRS without replacement using separate committed stage-swap seed
swapped_diagnostics.scope: descriptive six-way and binary order sensitivity only; retain failures and full diagnostic denominator; no primary quality gain or new independence claim

cost_budget.accounting: Log planned/started/completed/failed/skipped calls; raw outputs/errors, tokens, loading, context census, generation, all final hashing/serialization/exit costs, peak GPU allocation/reservation and separate process/scheduler memory. Infrastructure failure never silently replaces attempted labels.
